test_stimuli.name: ch1_full_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: Response bytes: [0x00, 0xFF, 0xC0]. high_byte=0xFF, low_byte=0xC0. raw = ((0xFF & 0x03) << 8) | 0xC0 = (3 << 8) | 192 = 768 + 192 = 960? But 1023 would be 0xFF & 0x03 = 3, low_byte=0xFF, raw=768+255=1023. So set low_byte=0xFF. Correct bytes: [0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF].
